blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent video generation models can produce highly realistic videos from natural language instructions, with visual quality approaching cinematic standards. Existing evaluation benchmarks, however, predominantly assess visual quality, aesthetic appeal and physical plausibility, while paying limited attention to text, an essential medium for conveying information in everyday scenes. A generated video may appear visually compelling and feature lifelike subjects, yet still render the text within the scene incorrectly. To address this overlooked dimension, we introduce VTR-Bench , a systematic benchmark for evaluating the V isual T ext R endering capabilities of video generation models. VTR-Bench situates text within concrete application scenarios, such as advertisements and scientific videos, with 300 carefully constructed prompts spanning five scenario categories. We develop an automated evaluation pipeline with human alignments that separately assesses text fidelity through carrier-specific transcription and scene and motion requirements through a prompt-specific chain of query. Beyond evaluation, we introduce a Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework in which a Director agent coordinates image and video generation with visual evaluation, guiding iterative refinement and candidate selection through visual feedback. Experiments on 11 state-of-the-art models reveal widespread difficulties in accurately rendering scene text, with the best-performing model recording an overall word error rate (WER) of 0.250. We further analyze text rendering failures to characterize the challenges faced by current video generation models. These findings highlight visual text rendering as a key challenge for video generation and demonstrate a practical path toward improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench .
blocks.zh: 近期的视频生成模型可以从自然语言指令中产生高度现实的视频,视觉质量接近电影标准. 然而,现有的评价基准主要评估视觉质量、审美吸引力和物理可信性,同时对文本的注意有限,这是在日常场景中传递信息的基本媒介。 生成的视频可能会显得具有视觉说服力,并呈现出类似生命的题材,但仍会使场景中的文字不正确. 为了解决这一被忽视的问题,我们引入了VTR-Bench,这是评价视频生成模型的V异构Text R内存能力的系统基准。 VTR-Bench将文本置于广告和科学视频等具体应用情景中,300个精心构建的提示涉及五个情景类别。 我们开发了一个与人对齐的自动评价管道,通过针对具体载体的抄录以及现场和运动要求,通过一个快速特定的查询链,分别评估文本的忠实性。 除了评价外,我们还采用一个关键框架指导代理框架,其中主任代理通过视觉评价协调图像和视频生成,指导迭代改进和通过视觉反馈选择候选人。 对11种最先进的模型的实验显示,在准确渲染场景文本方面存在着广泛的困难,最佳的模型记录了0.250的总的词错误率(WER). 我们进一步分析文本渲染失败,以描述目前视频生成模型所面临的挑战。 这些结论强调视觉文本的渲染是制作视频的关键挑战,并展示了一条实现改进的实用道路。 代码见https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench。

blocks.en: Recent advances in video generation models have enabled the synthesis of highly realistic videos, with visual quality approaching cinematic standards ( Kuaishou, 2024 ; Vidu AI, 2026 ; HappyHorse AI, 2026 ; MiniMaxAI, 2026 ; Bytedance Seed, 2026 ; Tongyi Wanxiang Team, 2026 ) . However, a convincing visual appearance does not necessarily mean that the text within a scene is correct ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . This distinction matters in applications such as advertisements, scientific demonstrations, and user interfaces, where text conveys essential information through product introduction, numerical values, and instructions ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . In these settings, incorrectly rendered words or symbols can change the intended message, making textual accuracy essential to the usefulness of the generated video. These practical demands motivate a crucial question: can video generation models render the required text accurately? As illustrated in Figure 1 , an approximately 10-second video contains misspelled words, repeated and incorrect text, and largely illegible passages. Although it achieves a Video Score of 0.90 on a checklist of scene and motion requirements, its word error rate (WER) ( Klakow & Peters, 2002 ) reaches 0.552. This example highlights a persistent challenge for current video generation models: accurately rendering visual text even when the surrounding scene and motion requirements are well satisfied.
blocks.zh: 最近视频生成模型的进步使得高度现实的视频得以合成,视觉质量接近电影标准(Kuaishou,2024年;Vidu AI,2026年;HappyHorse AI,2026年;MiniMaxAI,2026年;Bytedance) 种子, 2026; 通义万祥队, 2026 ). 然而,令人信服的视觉外观并不一定意味着场景中的文字是正确的(Liu等人,2024a; 刘等,2025). 这种区分在广告、科学演示和用户界面等应用中很重要,其中文本通过产品介绍、数值和说明传递基本信息(Guo等人,2025年)。 在这些设置中,不正确渲染的词或符号可以改变想要的信息,使得文本的准确性对于生成的视频的有用性至关重要. 这些实际需求引发了一个关键问题:视频生成模型能否准确制作所需的文本? 如图1所示,大约10秒的视频包含拼错的文字、重复的和不正确的文字以及基本上无法辨认的段落。 虽然它在场景和运动要求的核对表上实现了0.90的视频分数,但其单词错误率(WER)(Klakow & Peters,2002年)达到0.552. 这个例子凸显了当前视频生成模型的持久挑战:即使周围的场景和运动要求都得到了很好的满足,准确渲染视觉文本.

blocks.en: Existing video generation benchmarks primarily assess visual quality, prompt alignment, compositionality, and physical plausibility ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Meng et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2026 ) . Benchmarks that explicitly assess rendered text, including EvalCrafter ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , T2VTextBench ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , and AVGen-Bench ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , primarily cover short textual targets, with limited coverage of longer passages. In addition, T2VTextBench relies entirely on human evaluation, making repeated model evaluation labor-intensive. Scalable evaluation of longer scene text remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: 现有的视频生成基准主要评估视觉质量、即时对齐性、组成性以及物理可信度(Huang等人,2024年;Meng等人,2001年)。 2024; Sun等人,2025; Han等人,2025; Zheng等人,2025; Bansal等人,2025; Bansal等人,2026). 明确评估文本的基准,包括EvalCrafter(Liu等人,2024年b),T2VText Bench(Guo等人,2025年),以及AVGen-Bench(Zhou等人,2026年),主要包括短文本目标,篇幅有限的段落。 此外,T2VText Bench完全依靠人类评价,使得重复的模型评价劳动密集型. 对更长的场景文本的可扩展评价仍然未得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce VTR-Bench , a systematic benchmark for evaluating V isual T ext R endering in video generation. Its 300 carefully constructed prompts span advertising, science, user interfaces, culture, and daily life. Each scene contains multiple textual targets, from short labels to extended passages, with reference strings and carrier annotations specifying what should appear and where. To ground these textual requirements in coherent video scenarios, we adopt a multi-stage construction pipeline with human review. To enable scalable assessment, we develop an automated pipeline that decouples text fidelity from video requirements. A vision–language model transcribes text from specified carriers for comparison with reference strings using WER. In parallel, a prompt-specific chain of query containing 20 questions assesses scene and motion requirements to produce Video Score. Both evaluation branches are validated with human alignments.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了VTR-Bench,这是在视频生成中评价V isual T ext R endering的系统基准。 它的300个精心构建的提示横跨广告,科学,用户界面,文化和日常生活. 每个场景包含多个文字目标,从短标签到扩展段落,其中参考字符串和载体说明规定了应该出现的内容和地点. 为了将这些文字要求建立在连贯的视频情景中,我们采用了一个经过人文审查的多阶段施工管道。 为了能够进行可扩展的评估,我们开发了一个自动管道,使文本忠于视频的要求脱钩。 一个视觉-语言模型从指定的载体中转录文本,以便与使用WER的参考字符串进行比较. 同时,包含20个问题的快速特定查询链会评估场景和运动要求以制作视频分数. 这两个评价部门都经过人与人的配合验证。

blocks.en: Evaluation of 11 state-of-the-art video generation models reveals substantial text errors across both open-source and proprietary models, with the lowest overall WER at 0.250. Moreover, models with similar Video Scores exhibit markedly different text fidelity, separating adherence to scene and motion requirements from the correctness of rendered text. To improve visual text rendering, we develop a Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework whose Director agent coordinates image and video generation with visual evaluation, guiding iterative refinement and candidate selection through visual feedback. Compared with direct generation using Minimax H3 ( MiniMaxAI, 2026 ) , our framework reduces overall WER by 32.5% and improves Video Score. The full framework also improves both aggregate metrics over direct first-frame conditioning, demonstrating the value of coordinated refinement beyond supplying an initial image. Our main contributions are as follows: • We introduce VTR-Bench , a systematic benchmark for evaluating visual text rendering in video generation. By embedding prescribed text in concrete scenes across five application scenarios, VTR-Bench assesses models’ ability to render textual information in context, with explicit requirements for its content and carriers. • We develop an automated evaluation pipeline with human alignments that combines carrier-specific transcription and a prompt-specific chain of query to separately assess textual accuracy and fulfillment of video requirements. Our Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework guides image and video generation through visual evaluation, iterative refinement, and candidate selection. • Experimental results on a wide range of state-of-the-art models reveal systematic difficulties in reproducing textual information across diverse video scenarios, highlighting faithful visual text rendering as an essential capability for advancing video generation.
blocks.zh: 对11个最先进的视频生成模型的评价显示,在开源和专有模型中存在大量文字错误,总体WER最低为0.250. 此外,具有类似视频分数的模型显示出明显不同的文本忠贞性,将遵守场景和运动要求与所渲染文本的正确性区分开来。 为了改进视觉文本的渲染,我们开发了一个关键框架-指导代理框架,其主任代理通过视觉反馈协调图像和视频生成,指导迭代完善和候选人选择。 与使用Minimax H3(MiniMaxAI, 2026)直接生成相比,我们的框架将WER总体减少32.5%,并改进视频分数. 整个框架还改进了两个总的衡量标准,而不是直接的第一帧条件,表明除了提供初步图像之外,协调改进的价值。 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们引入了VTR-Bench, 一个系统基准, VTR-Bench通过将规定的文本嵌入五个应用情景的具体场景中,评估模型根据具体情况提供文本信息的能力,并明确要求其内容和载体。 我们开发了一个自动评价管道,将具体载体的抄录和快速的查询链结合起来,以分别评估文字准确性和视频要求的满足情况。 我们的关键框架指导代理框架通过视觉评价、迭代改进和候选人选择指导图像和视频生成。 · 各种最新模型的实验结果表明,在不同视频情景中复制文本信息存在系统性困难,突出忠实的视觉文本渲染是推进视频生成的基本能力.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Text Rendering in Videos
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频中的视觉文本渲染

blocks.en: Visual text rendering in videos requires preserving textual accuracy under motion, deformation, and changes in visibility. Text-Animator combines text embedding injection, camera control, and text refinement ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . Approaches to this problem span model design and synthetic-data training: HunyuanVideo 1.5 incorporates ByT5-based glyph encoding ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , while Video Text Preservation fine-tunes Wan2.1 on synthetic text-rich videos ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Related settings address complementary problems: FlowText synthesizes scene text in existing videos for video text spotting ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) ; Dynamic Typography and KineTy animate the glyphs themselves ( Liu et al., 2024d ; Park et al., 2024 ) ; and STRIVE and SteerVTE edit text in source videos ( G et al., 2021 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) . VTR-Bench evaluates how accurately video generation models render prescribed text on designated carriers while satisfying the surrounding scene requirements.
blocks.zh: 视频中的视觉文本渲染需要在运动,变形,可见度变化下保持文字精度. 文本动画师结合文本嵌入注入,相机控制,以及文本的精细化(Liu等人,2024a). 解决这一问题的方法跨越模型设计和合成数据培训:HunyuanVideo 1.5 采用了基于ByT5的glyph编码(Wu等人,2025a),而视频文本保存则在合成文本丰富的视频上微调Wan2.1(Liu等人,2025年)。 相关环境涉及互补问题: FlowText综合了现有视频中的场景文本,用于视频文本的显示(Zhao等人,2023年);动态打字法和KineTy动画本身(Liu等人,2024年d;Park等人,2024年d);以及STRIVE和SirVTE编辑源视频中的文本(G等人,2021年;Zeng等人,2026年). VTR-Bench评价视频生成模型在满足周围场景要求的同时,如何准确地将规定的文本提供给指定的载体.

blocks.en: 2.2 Video Generation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 视频生成基准

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks assess video generation from several complementary perspectives. General benchmarks such as FETV ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , and EvalCrafter ( Liu et al., 2024b ) evaluate generation quality and prompt adherence across multiple dimensions, including visual quality, motion quality, and video-text alignment. VBench-2.0 ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) further extends evaluation to intrinsic faithfulness, covering human fidelity, controllability, creativity, physics, and commonsense. Video-Bench ( Han et al., 2025 ) introduces chain-of-query and few-shot scoring to improve alignment with human judgments. Beyond general-purpose evaluation, specialized benchmarks examine specific capabilities: T2V-CompBench ( Sun et al., 2025 ) evaluates compositional generation, while TC-Bench ( Feng et al., 2025 ) examines temporal compositionality. PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2024 ) , VideoPhy ( Bansal et al., 2025 ) , and VideoPhy-2 ( Bansal et al., 2026 ) evaluate physical commonsense, while RulerBench ( He et al., 2025 ) and Sci-VBench ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) evaluate reasoning capabilities. As video generation models increasingly incorporate audio, recent benchmarks have expanded evaluation to audiovisual generation ( Mao et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Hua et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond audiovisual synchronization and cross-modal alignment, PhyAVBench ( Xie et al., 2025 ) and AV-Phys Bench ( Cui et al., 2026 ) extend the evaluation of physical plausibility to audio-video generation. LongAV-Compass ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , MSAVBench ( Wei et al., 2026 ) , and MultiRef-Compass ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) target minute-scale, multi-shot, and multi-reference-conditioned audio-video generation, respectively. Text rendering has also received dedicated attention. T2VTextBench ( Guo et al., 2025 ) uses human evaluation to assess on-screen text fidelity and temporal consistency, while AVGen-Bench ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) incorporates scene text rendering into its broader audiovisual evaluation suite. VTR-Bench evaluates visual text rendering across five application scenarios by automatically transcribing text from designated carriers and computing word error rate against reference text.
blocks.zh: 现有基准从几个互补的角度评估视频生成。 FETV(刘等人,2023年),V Bench(黄等人,2024年),EvalCrafter等一般基准. (Liu et al., 2024b)评价生成质量,迅速遵守多个维度,包括视觉质量,运动质量,以及视频文本对齐. V Bench-2.0(郑等人,2025年)将评价范围进一步扩大到内在的忠诚,涵盖人类忠诚,可控性,创造力,物理,以及常识. Video-Bench(Han 等人,2025年)引入了连锁排气和几弹评分,以提高与人类判断的一致性. 除普通用途评价外,专门基准还审查具体能力:T2V-Comp Bench(Sun等人,2025年)评价组成生成,TC-Bench(Feng等人,2025年)审查时间组成。 PhyGen Bench(Meng等人,2024年),视频 Phy(Bansal等人,2025年)和视频 Phy-2(Bansal等人,2026年)评价物理常识,而Ruder Bench(He等人,2025年)和Sci-V Bench(Zhang等人,2026年a)评价推理能力. 随着视频生成模式越来越多地纳入音频,最近的基准将评价扩大到视听生成(Mao等人,2024年;Cao等人,2025年;Hua等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026a年;Yang等人,2026年)。 除了视听同步和跨模式对接之外,PhyAV Bench(Xie等人,2025年)和AV-Phys Bench(Cui等人,2026年)将物理可信度的评价扩展到音频视频生成. LongAV-Compass (Liu et al., 2026b), MSAV Bench (Wei et al., 2026),以及MultiRef-Compass (Zhang et al., 2026b) 目标分级,多镜头,以及多参考条件的音频视频生成分别. 文本渲染也得到专注. T2VText Bench(Guo等人,2025年)利用人类评价来评估屏幕上文本的忠实性和时间一致性,而AVGen-Bench(周等人,2026年)则将场景文本渲染纳入其更广泛的视听评价套件. VTR-Bench通过从指定的载体自动转录文本,并对照参考文本计算字数错误率,对五种应用情景的视觉文本渲染进行评价.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集建设

blocks.en: We build the prompt suite of VTR-Bench via a multi-stage pipeline that combines scene seed curation, prompt construction, and visual feasibility validation, as shown in Figure 2 . To establish broad coverage of visual text in context, human experts firstly define five high-level scenario categories. Within these categories, GPT-5.6 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) generates diverse scene seeds describing the core scene and events, the purpose of the text, and candidate carriers. These seeds are then screened and deduplicated by human reviewers to balance scenario coverage. Building on the curated seeds, DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) is used to construct complete prompts that specify textual content, carrier assignments, and semantic relationships, thereby grounding the texts in concrete scene contexts.
blocks.zh: 正如图2所示,我们通过一个多阶段管道建造了VTR-Bench的快速套件,该套件结合了场景种子校准、快速施工和视觉可行性验证。 为了在背景中确立视觉文本的广泛范围,人类专家首先界定了五个高级别情景类别。 在这些类别中,GPT-5.6(OpenAI,2026年)产生多种场景种子,描述核心场景和事件,文字目的,以及候选载体. 这些种子随后由人类审查人员进行筛选和变质,以平衡情景覆盖范围。 在编织种子的基础上,DeepSeek-V4-Flash(DeepSeek-AI,2026年)用于构建完整的提示,明确文字内容,载体任务,以及语义关系,从而将文本建立在具体的场景背景中.

blocks.en: To assess whether the specified text and carriers can be accommodated within a coherent scene, we design an iterative validation mechanism that combines reference images, VLM feedback, and final human review. Specifically, three reference images produced by an image generation model serve as visual evidence for a VLM to assess each candidate prompt and identify requirements that need revision. This feedback guides prompt refinement, with each revised candidate evaluated using three newly generated images. The mechanism also includes a re-synthesis step: three consecutive unsuccessful checks trigger DeepSeek-V4-Flash to reconstruct the candidate before restarting validation. To verify the resulting prompts before inclusion, a final human review follows successful visual validation. The resulting suite contains 300 prompts spanning advertising, science, user interfaces, culture, and daily life. Within this suite, each sample pairs a video generation prompt with reference strings and carrier descriptions, making both the intended text and its location explicit for subsequent evaluation. Further details of dataset construction are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为了评估能否在一个连贯的场景中容纳特定的文本和载体,我们设计了一个迭代验证机制,将参考图像,VLM反馈和最后的人文审查结合起来. 具体来说,由图像生成模型制作的3个参考图像作为虚拟LM的视觉证据,用于迅速评估每个候选者并确定需要修改的要求。 这些反馈指导着迅速改进,每个订正候选人使用三个新生成的图像进行评价。 机制还包括一个再合成步骤:连续三次不成功的检查触发DeepSeek-V4-Flash在重启验证前重建候选者. 为了在录入前验证由此产生的提示,在视觉验证成功后进行最后的人类审查. 由此产生的套间包含300个横跨广告、科学、用户界面、文化和日常生活的提示。 在这个套间中,每个样片对一组带参考字符串和载体描述的视频生成,使预定文本及其位置都明确,供日后评价. 数据集建设的进一步详情见附录B。

blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集统计

blocks.en: Figure 3: Dataset statistics of VTR-Bench.
blocks.zh: 图3:VTR-Bench数据集统计.

blocks.en: VTR-Bench contains 300 prompts evenly distributed across five application scenarios, with 60 per category. Figure 3a summarizes the 25 sub-scenes covered. Each prompt requires models to render multiple text blocks within a scene, with textual content ranging from short labels to extended passages. A text block denotes an annotated textual target with a reference string and a specified carrier. As shown in Figure 3b , the suite contains 1,202 text blocks, with two to six blocks per prompt and 94.3% of prompts requiring three to five blocks. Beyond this multiplicity, the suite spans a broad range of text lengths, measured using the evaluation tokenizer described in Section 3.3 . The distributions in Figures 3c and 3d show that the total required text length per video ranges from 58 to 496 tokens, with a median of 102.5, while individual blocks range from 1 to 275 tokens, with a median of 23. Together, these properties make VTR-Bench a test of both rendering multiple textual targets within a scene and reproducing longer passages accurately.
blocks.zh: VTR-Bench包含在5种应用情景中均匀分布的300个提示,每类60个. 图3a概述了所涵盖的25次子场景。 每个提示都需要模型在一个场景内制成多个文本块,文字内容从短标签到扩展段落不等. 文本块表示带有参考字符串和指定载体的附加说明的文本目标。 如图3b所示,该套房包含1,202个文字块,每块有2至6个块,94.3%的便便需要3至5个块. 除了这种多重性之外,套间还使用第3.3节所述的评价标注器测量了广泛的文本长度。 图3c和图3d的分布显示,每部视频所需的文本总长度为58至496个令牌,中间值为102.5,而单个区块则从1至275个令牌,中间值为23. 这些属性加在一起,使得VTR-Bench既能使一个场景内出现多个文字目标,又能准确复制较长的段落.

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准评价

blocks.en: To distinguish fulfillment of scene and motion requirements from visual text accuracy, we design a decoupled evaluation pipeline that measures these two aspects through Video Score and word error rate (WER). Figure 2 illustrates the two evaluation branches: prompt-specific chain-of-query (CoQ) evaluation and carrier-specific text transcription followed by reference comparison.
blocks.zh: 为了区分场景和运动要求的实现和视觉文本的准确性,我们设计了一个脱钩的评价管道,通过视频评分和文字误差率(WER)衡量这两个方面。 图2说明了两个评价处:即即时特定序号评价(CoQ)和承运人专用文本抄录,然后进行参考比较。

blocks.en: To assess how faithfully a video realizes the requested scene and motion, we adopt query-based evaluation ( Han et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) and construct a CoQ of 20 questions for each prompt. Generated by GPT-5.6 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and reviewed by human annotators, the queries are tailored to the requirements of each prompt. Across the prompt suite, they span five dimensions: Scene Attributes , Motion Adherence , Spatial Relationship , Entity Presence , and Temporal Consistency , with each CoQ addressing the dimensions relevant to its prompt. Each question expresses an observable requirement, allowing a VLM to evaluate its fulfillment with a yes or no answer. Video Score is the proportion of satisfied requirements, VideoScore ⁡ ( v ) = 1 20 ​ ∑ j = 1 20 y v , j \operatorname{VideoScore}(v)=\frac{1}{20}\sum_{j=1}^{20}y_{v,j} , where y v , j = 1 y_{v,j}=1 for a yes answer and 0 0 otherwise.
blocks.zh: 为了评估一段视频如何忠实地实现所请求的场景和动作,我们采用了基于查询的评价(Han等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年),并为每个提示构建一个20个问题的CoQ. 由GPT-5.6(OpenAI,2026年)生成,并经过人文注释员审查,查询内容根据每个提示的要求量身定制. 在整个快速套间中,它们跨越五个维度:场景属性、运动遵守、空间关系、实体存在和时间一致性,每个联合调查表都述及与其快速相关的维度。 每个问题都表达了一个可观察到的要求,允许一个甚高频以 " 是 " 或 " 没有 " 答案评价其实现情况。 Video Score是满足要求的比例,VideoScore QQ(v)= 1 20 j = 1 20 y y y v,j\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\

blocks.en: For visual text evaluation, a VLM transcribes each specified carrier from its clearest occurrence in the video, guided by carrier descriptions and the generation prompt with reference text masked. Transcriptions preserve rendering errors and omit unreadable spans; missing or entirely unreadable targets yield empty strings. We then compare these transcriptions with the reference text using WER.

blocks.en: 3.4 Keyframe-Guided Agentic Generation
blocks.zh: 3.4 关键框架指导剂生成

blocks.en: To explore inference-time control of visual text rendering, we design a keyframe-guided agentic generation framework that establishes a first-frame representation of the requested scene before introducing motion. As illustrated in Figure 4 , a Director agent coordinates image generation, motion planning, and video generation through visual feedback. Given the generation prompt, the Director agent constructs an image prompt and requests candidate first frames. A VLM inspects these candidates for text accuracy, legibility, carrier coverage, and scene consistency. Based on these observations, the Director agent can compare candidates, refine the image prompt for another generation, or edit an existing candidate by supplying the image and a targeted editing instruction. This feedback guides selection of the first frame that will condition video generation.
blocks.zh: 为了探索对视觉文本渲染的推断-时间控制,我们设计了一个键框制导的代理生成框架,在引入运动前确定对请求的场景的第一帧代表. 如图4所示,一名主任代理通过视觉反馈协调图像生成、运动规划和视频生成。 鉴于生成提示, 主任代理构建图像提示并请求候选人第一帧 。 一个VLM检查这些候选人的文本准确性,可辨别性,载体覆盖度和场景一致性. 基于这些观察,局长代理可以比较候选人,完善另一代人的图像提示,或者通过提供图像和有针对性的编辑指导来编辑现有的候选人. 这种反馈指导了第一个框架的选择,它将限制视频生成。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Keyframe-guided agentic generation. A Director agent uses visual feedback to refine image prompts, edit or regenerate first frames, and revise motion plans. The selected first frame, original prompt, and motion plan condition video generation.
blocks.zh: 图4:关键框架制导剂生成。 一个导演代理使用视觉反馈来完善图像提示,编辑或再生第一帧,并修改运动计划. 所选的第一帧,原速,和动计划条件视频生成.

blocks.en: To animate the selected scene, the Director agent constructs a motion plan specifying subject actions, camera movement, and temporal progression. The video generator receives the selected first frame together with the original prompt and the motion plan, retaining the same model weights used for direct video generation. A VLM then reviews sampled video frames for text stability, carrier persistence, motion coherence, and adherence to the requested content. These observations guide motion-plan refinement and further video generation, while candidate comparison supports final video selection. Throughout the process, the Director agent chooses subsequent actions and their instructions from the available tools based on accumulated visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 为了激活所选场景,局长代理设计了一个动议计划,具体说明主题动作,相机移动和时间进展. 视频生成器接收了选定的第一帧连同原速率和运动计划,保留了直接视频生成所使用的相同的模型重量. 然后,一个VLM审查所取样的视频帧,以了解文本稳定性、载体持久性、运动一致性和遵守要求的内容。 这些意见指导了行动计划的完善和进一步的视频生成,而候选人比较则支持最后的视频选择。 在整个过程中,主任代理人根据累积的视觉证据,从现有工具中选择后续行动及其指示。

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate a variety of models, including both open-sourced models and proprietary models. For open-sourced models, we test Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , Hunyuanvideo-1.5 ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , LTX-2.3 ( HaCohen et al., 2025 ) , Lingbot-Video ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , including Lingbot-Video-Dense and Lingbot-Video-MOE and Minimax H3 ( MiniMaxAI, 2026 ) . For Proprietary Models, we evaluate kling v3.0 ( Kuaishou, 2024 ) , happyhorse1.1 ( HappyHorse AI, 2026 ) , ViduQ3 ( Vidu AI, 2026 ) , Wan-3.0 ( Tongyi Wanxiang Team, 2026 ) and seedance2.5 ( Bytedance Seed, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价各种模型,包括开源模型和专有模型。 对于开源型号,我们测试了Wan2.2-TI2V-5B(Wan等人,2025年),Hunyuanvideo-1.5(Wu等人,2025年a),LTX-2.3(HaCohen等人,2025年),Lingbot-Video(Ma等人,2026年),包括Lingbot-Video-Dense和Lingbot-Video-MOE和Minimax H3(MinimaxAI,2026年). (原始内容存档于2017-03-03). 維杜Q3(Vidu AI,2026),Wan-3.0(Tongyi Wanxiang Team,2026)和种子2.5(Bytedance种子,2026).

blocks.en: For open sourced models, we use the unified framework vllm-omni ( Yin et al., 2026 ) for generation, and each model is set with the default optimal generation settings of itself, except for the video length. For Proprietary models, we set the resolution to 720p. The video length is fixed to 10 seconds with a 24 FPS. All of the generation experiments are conducted on NVIDIA H20 GPUs. For VLM evaluator, we use Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) for both video and visual text rendering evaluation. Evaluation runs on NVIDIA A800 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 对于开源模型,我们使用统一的框架 vllm-omni(Yin et al., 2026)进行生成,每个模型都设定了自身默认的最佳生成设置,除了视频长度. 对于专有模式,我们设定分辨率为720p. 视频长度固定为10秒,配有24台FPS. 所有生成实验都是在NVIDIA H20 GPU上进行的. 对于VLM评价员,我们使用Quen3.8-27B(Quen Team,2026c)同时进行视频和视觉文本渲染评价. 评价在NVIDIA A800 GPU上运行.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results on VTextBench. The top three results in each metric are highlighted in blue, with darker shades indicating better performance.
blocks.zh: 表1:VText Bench的主要结果. 每个度量中前三名的成绩以蓝色突出,较暗的阴影表明表现较好.

blocks.en: We report the main results in Table 1 , revealing two key findings. Visual text rendering remains challenging for current video generation models. High WERs are prevalent across the evaluated models, and even the strongest model records an overall WER of 0.250. Among open-source models, Minimax H3 stands out with a WER of 0.447, while most others remain close to the metric’s upper bound across the five scenarios. This broad pattern shows that their text rendering difficulties extend across application contexts. Proprietary models also differ substantially in text fidelity. Wan3.0 leads text fidelity in every scenario, with Seedance2.5 following within this group, but several other proprietary models still produce substantial text errors and do not match Minimax H3. The results therefore reveal substantial differences within each group, alongside a shared challenge in reproducing the requested text faithfully. VTR-Bench distinguishes these capabilities by testing whether models reproduce the specified textual content across diverse scene contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中报告了主要结果,揭示了两个关键的调查结果。 视觉文本渲染对于目前的视频生成模型来说仍然具有挑战性. 高WER在被评价的模型中普遍存在,甚至最强的模型记录的总WER为0.250. 在开源模型中,Minimax H3以0.447的WER出名,而大多数其他模型仍然接近在五种情景中的度量值上限。 这种广泛的格局表明,其文本在提供各种应用环境方面的困难。 专有模式在文本忠实性方面也有很大不同。 Wan3.0在每种情景中引导文本忠实,种子2.5在此组内遵循,但其他几种专有模型仍然产生大量文本错误,与Minimax H3不匹配. 因此,结果表明,每个组内部都存在很大差异,同时在忠实地转载所要求的案文方面也面临共同的挑战。 VTR-Bench通过测试模型是否在不同场景背景中复制指定的文字内容来区分这些能力.

blocks.en: High Video Scores do not guarantee accurate visual text. Proprietary models achieve consistently high Video Scores, yet differ substantially in text fidelity. Kling v3.0 and Seedance2.5 provide a clear example: both score approximately 0.79 on video requirements, while their WERs are 0.979 and 0.641, respectively. Thus, nearly identical fulfillment of scene and motion requirements can accompany markedly different text accuracy. The same distinction appears across model groups: Minimax H3 renders text more accurately than most proprietary models despite receiving a lower Video Score. These comparisons show that a model’s ability to realize the requested scene does not establish whether the text conveys the intended information. Correct actions, entities, and spatial relationships can coexist with incorrect textual content. By evaluating these aspects separately, VTR-Bench exposes a gap that a high Video Score can obscure and identifies visual text rendering as a distinct dimension of video generation capability.
blocks.zh: 高视频 分数并不能保证准确的视觉文本. 专有模式实现了一贯的高视频分数,但在文本忠诚度方面却大不相同。 Kling v3.0和种子2.5提供了一个明显的例子:两者在视频要求上都得分约为0.79,而他们的WER分别是0.979和0.641. 因此,在文字准确性明显不同的同时,场景和动作要求的实现几乎完全相同。 同样的区别出现在各示范组: Minimax H3 使得文本比大多数专有模型更准确,尽管收到了较低的视频分数. 这些比较表明,一个模型实现所请求的场景的能力不能确定文本是否传达了预期的信息. 正确的行动、实体和空间关系可以与不正确的文字内容共存。 通过分别评估这些方面,VTR-Bench暴露出一个漏洞,一个高视频分数可以遮掩并识别视觉文本渲染是视频生成能力的一个独特方面.

blocks.en: 4.3 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 失败分析

blocks.en: To better understand visual text rendering failures, we examine them from two perspectives: the effect of generation settings and the transcription outcomes reported by the VLM evaluator.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解视觉文本渲染失败,我们从两个角度来考察这些失败:生成设置的效果和VLM评价员报告的抄录结果.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Effects of generation resolution and duration. Left: Video Score ( ↑ \uparrow ). Right: WER ( ↓ \downarrow ).
blocks.zh: 图5:生成分辨率和持续时间的影响。 左边:视频分数( QQ )\ oparrow ) 。 右:WER (\\ downarrow ).

blocks.en: Higher resolution can allocate more pixels to text at a comparable relative scale, while shorter videos reduce the temporal span over which text must remain consistent. To examine how these factors affect text fidelity, we compare four combinations of high/low resolution and long/short duration for Minimax H3 and LTX-2.3. For Minimax H3, the high and low resolutions are 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 and 832 × 480 832\times 480 , respectively; for LTX-2.3, they are 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 and 768 × 512 768\times 512 . Long and short durations correspond to 10 and 5 seconds for both models.
blocks.zh: 更高的分辨率可以在可比的相对尺度上为文本分配更多的像素,而较短的视频则缩短了文本必须保持一致的时间跨度. 为了审查这些因素如何影响文本的忠实性,我们比较了Minimax H3和LTX-2.3四个高/低分辨率和长/短期限的组合。 对于Minimax H3,高低分辨率分别为1344×768 1344\时,768和832×480 832\时,480;对于LTX-2.3,高低分辨率分别为1280×704 1280\时,768×512 768\时,512. 长和短的长度对应于两个模型的10秒和5秒.

blocks.en: The response to generation settings reflects differences in underlying text-rendering capability. As shown in Figure 5 , higher resolution reduces WER for Minimax H3 at both durations, allowing its stronger text-rendering ability to benefit from greater spatial detail. In contrast, LTX-2.3 maintains a WER close to 1 across all four configurations despite changes in Video Score. Shortening duration likewise provides no consistent improvement in text fidelity across the two models. Together, these results suggest that higher resolution can enhance an existing capacity to render text, while configuration changes alone do not resolve the text errors observed in LTX-2.3. Strengthening the model’s underlying text-rendering capability is therefore central to realizing the benefits of improved generation settings.
blocks.zh: 对生成设置的反应反映了基本文本发送能力的差异. 如图5所示,更高的分辨率减少了Minimax H3在两个期间的WER,使其更强大的文本传递能力能够从更大的空间细节中受益. 相比之下,LTX-2.3在所有四个配置中都保持接近1的WER,尽管Video Score有所变化. 同样,缩短期限也不能持续改善两种模式的文字忠诚度。 这些结果合在一起表明,更高的分辨率可以加强现有的文本渲染能力,而仅凭配置变化并不能解决LTX-2.3中观察到的文本错误. 因此,加强模型的基本文本提供能力对于实现改进生成环境的好处至关重要。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Transcription outcomes reported by VLM evaluator. Bars show the proportion of text targets in each state.
blocks.zh: 图 6: 自愿活动评价员报告的转录结果。 栏显示每个州文本目标的比例.

blocks.en: To examine how these capability differences manifest in generated text, we analyze Qwen3.8-27B’s transcription outcomes for 13,213 text targets across videos. The evaluator uses three states predefined before evaluation: carrier not found , text unreadable , and transcribed . Here, text unreadable indicates that the carrier is found but its entire text is unreadable. Figure 6 shows the distribution of these states. Across models, the evaluator reports unreadable text for 23.31% of targets, compared with 9.34% for carriers not found. This pattern points to difficulties recovering text even after its carrier has been located. Such outcomes are particularly prevalent for Wan2.2-5B and LTX-2.3, where over half of the targets are judged unreadable, consistent with their high WERs.
blocks.zh: 我们分析Qune3. 8-27B的13 213个视频文本目标的转录结果。 评价者在评价前使用预先定义的三个状态:载体未发现,文本无法读取,以及转录。 在此,无法读取的文本表明承运人被发现,但其整个文本无法读取。 图6显示这些州的分布情况。 在整个模型中,评价者报告23.31%的目标无法读取,而没有找到的载体为9.34%。 这种模式表明,即使在承运人找到之后也难以找到案文。 在Wan2.2-5B和LTX-2.3中,这种结果尤其普遍,其中一半以上的目标被认为无法读取,这与其高的WER一致。

blocks.en: Transcribability does not establish textual accuracy. Kling v3.0 has a transcription rate of 79.62% but an overall WER of 0.979, whereas Minimax H3 combines a transcription rate of 85.61% with a WER of 0.447. Thus, substantial transcription coverage can coexist with extensive errors against the required content. These observations identify two priorities for visual text rendering: legible text on the intended carriers and accurate reproduction of the prescribed content.
blocks.zh: 可传输性不能确定文本的准确性。 Kling v3.0的转录率为79.62%,但总体WER为0.979,而Minimax H3的转录率为85.61%,WER为0.447。 因此,大量记录可以同时存在与所需内容相悖的广泛错误。 这些意见确定了视觉文本渲染的两个优先事项:关于预期载体的清晰文本和准确复制规定内容。

blocks.en: 4.4 Effect of Test-Time Refinement
blocks.zh: 4.4 完善试验时间的效果

blocks.en: To examine whether inference-time control improves visual text rendering, we compare three generation settings using Minimax H3: direct generation from the prompt, denoted as Original ; I2V , which takes the original prompt and the first image generated by the agentic framework as input; and Agentic , the full framework described in Section 3.4 . For the agentic framework, Qwen3.7-plus ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) serves as both the Director agent and the VLM, while Qwen-Image-3.0 ( Qwen Team, 2026d ) serve as the image generator. For both I2V and Agentic generation, we remove the first frame of each generated video before evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了检查推断时间控制是否改善了视觉文本渲染,我们比较了使用Minimax H3的三代设置:从即时直接生成,表示为Origin ;I2V,将原始即时和代理框架生成的第一个图像作为输入;以及Agentic,第3.4节描述的全部框架. 对于代理框架,Quen3.7-plus(Quen Team,2026b)同时担任主任代理和VLM,而Quen-Image-3.0(Quen Team,2026d)则担任图像生成器. 对于I2V和Agentic生成,我们都会在评价前删除每个生成的视频的第一个帧.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Comparison of direct generation, I2V, and the agentic framework on Minimax H3. Bold values indicate the best result within each scenario or overall.
blocks.zh: 图7:直接生成I2V和Minimax H3上的代理框架比较. 粗体值表示每个情景或总体中的最佳结果。

blocks.en: Test-time refinement improves both text fidelity and fulfillment of video requirements. As shown in Figure 7 , the agentic framework reduces overall WER from 0.4468 to 0.3015, a 32.5% relative reduction, while raising Video Score from 0.7562 to 0.8315. Both metrics improve across all five scenarios relative to direct generation. These results show that explicit first-frame construction and visual feedback can improve text fidelity alongside adherence to scene and motion requirements, using the same video generator.
blocks.zh: 测试时间的完善既改善了文本的忠实性,也提高了视频要求的满足性。 如图7所示,代理框架将总体WER从0.4468减少到0.3015,相对减少32.5%,同时将视频分数从0.7562提高到0.8315。 在所有5种情景中,这两个指标都与直接生成相比有所改善。 这些结果表明,明确的第一帧构造和视觉反馈可以改善文本的忠实性,同时遵守场景和运动要求,使用同样的视频生成器.

blocks.en: The full framework provides gains beyond first-frame conditioning alone. I2V improves both aggregate metrics over direct generation, while the full framework further reduces overall WER by 9.4% relative to I2V and achieves the highest Video Score in every scenario. Its WER advantage over I2V spans four of the five scenarios and is largest in scientific videos; in UI scenes, I2V achieves the lowest WER, while the full framework achieves the highest Video Score. Thus, the full framework improves on initial image conditioning through visual refinement and motion planning.
blocks.zh: 整个框架提供的收益超出了第一个框架。 I2V在直接生成上改进了两种总的度量,而全框架则进一步将整体WER比I2V减少9.4%,并在每个场景中实现最高的视频分数. 其WER对I2V的优势跨越了五个情景中的四个,在科学视频中最大;在UI场景中,I2V实现最低WER,而全框架实现最高的视频分数. 因此,整个框架通过视觉改进和运动规划改进了最初的图像配置。

blocks.en: 4.5 Human Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.5 人类和谐

blocks.en: To assess alignment with human judgments, we compare Qwen3.8-27B’s evaluations with human annotations on 100 sampled videos, covering 2,000 CoQ judgments and 404 text blocks. Guided by the transcription outcomes in Figure 6 , we sample more videos from Seedance2.5, Minimax H3, and Wan3.0, which combine high transcription rates with relatively low overall WERs. This choice prioritizes examples with recoverable text for human comparison. Three human annotators provide annotations for each binary query and text block. For each binary query, the majority vote serves as the human reference. As shown in Table 2 , the automated evaluator agrees with this majority on 92.15% of the queries, indicating consistent judgments of scene and motion requirement fulfillment.
blocks.zh: 为了评估与人类判断的一致性,我们将Quen3.8-27B的评价与100个抽样视频的人类说明进行比较,涵盖2000个CoQ判断和404个文本块. 以图6中的转录结果为指导,我们从种子2.5、Minimax H3和Wan3.0中抽取了更多的视频,这些视频结合了高转录率和相对较低的总体WER. 这一选择优先处理带有可检索文本的例子,供人类比较。 三个人类注释器为每个二进制查询和文本块提供注释. 对于每一个二进制查询,多数投票作为人类的参考. 如表2所示,自动评价员同意92.15%的查询占多数,表明对现场和运动要求的判断一致。

blocks.zh: 表2: Quen3.8-27B对齐。

blocks.en: For visual text evaluation, we compute WER from each transcription against the same benchmark reference text. We average the three annotators’ WERs for each text block or video and compare these averages with the corresponding VLM-derived scores. The strong Pearson and Spearman correlations indicate close agreement between human and VLM assessments of text error severity and relative rankings. This correspondence also extends to numerical agreement: video-level Lin’s concordance correlation coefficient reaches 0.9835, with a mean absolute error of 0.0407. Together, these results demonstrate strong agreement between automated and human evaluation across both branches.
blocks.zh: 对于视觉文本评价,我们从每份抄录中根据同一个基准参考文本计算WER. 我们平均是三位笔记家。 每个文本块或视频的WER,并将这些平均值与相应的VLM衍生的分数进行比较. 强烈的皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼的关联性表明人类和VLM对文本错误严重性的评价和相对排名的密切一致. 此函证也延伸至数字协议:视频级Lin的和谐关联系数达到0.9835,平均绝对误差为0.0407. 这些结果加在一起表明,两个处的自动化评价与人类评价之间有着强烈的一致。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: VTR-Bench establishes visual text rendering as a distinct criterion for assessing whether generated videos faithfully convey the information specified by users. By grounding textual requirements in concrete application scenarios, the benchmark connects text accuracy to the activities, objects, and interfaces through which written information serves a purpose. Our evaluation of 11 state-of-the-art models shows that this capability remains a shared challenge across open-source and proprietary systems, with the strongest model recording an overall WER of 0.250. The resulting failure analysis makes this challenge more concrete: text can fail to become readable, or remain legible while conveying incorrect content. Progress therefore requires both recognizable characters and faithful reproduction of the intended information. The improvements achieved by our Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework further show that visual feedback can guide generation toward this goal, reducing overall WER by 32.5% while improving Video Score on Minimax H3. These findings motivate evaluating visual text as part of a video’s communicative function, alongside its depiction of scenes and actions. This perspective provides a basis for studying how scene complexity, textual density, and motion affect text fidelity, with explicit content requirements serving as evaluation targets. We hope VTR-Bench will support the development of video generation models whose written content is as faithful to user intent as the scenes they create.
blocks.zh: VTR-Bench将视觉文本渲染确定为评估生成的视频是否忠实传递用户指定的信息的单独标准. 通过在具体应用情景中确定文字要求的基础,基准将文字准确性与书面信息服务于目的的活动、对象和界面联系起来。 我们对11个最新模型的评价表明,这一能力仍然是开源和专有系统的共同挑战,最强模型记录的总WER为0.250。 由此产生的失败分析使这一挑战更加具体:文本可能无法读取,或者在传达不正确内容的同时仍然清晰可见。 因此,要取得进展,既需要识别人物,也需要忠实地复制预定的信息。 我们的关键框架指导代理框架的改进进一步表明,视觉反馈可以引导生成人朝这个目标前进,将WER整体减少32.5%,同时改善Minimax H3上的视频分数. 这些结论促使人们评价视觉文本,将其作为视频传播功能的一部分,同时评价其描绘场景和行动。 这种观点为研究场景的复杂性、文字密度和运动如何影响文字的忠实性提供了依据,明确的内容要求可作为评价目标。 我们希望VTR-Bench将支持开发视频生成模型,其书面内容与他们创造的场景一样忠实于用户意图.

blocks.en: Appendix A More Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 更相关的工作

blocks.en: Research on image text rendering has developed from explicit character and layout control toward native text modeling and targeted refinement. TextDiffuser, Glyph-ByT5, and AnyText2 establish useful mechanisms for layout planning, character-aware representation, and attribute control ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024c ; Tuo et al., 2024 ) . Recent work strengthens these capabilities through complementary approaches. Qwen-Image combines text-focused data curation with progressive training that extends to paragraph-level text ( Wu et al., 2025b ) . TextGuider addresses text omission through attention alignment, while DCText separates long or multiple strings into designated regions using scheduled attention masks ( Baek et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ) . GlyphAnchor introduces position-anchored glyph priors, and TextPecker improves structural fidelity through rewards sensitive to character-level anomalies ( Xiang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . PosterMaker and BizGen further study product posters and article-level infographics ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . These developments emphasize text completeness, placement, and dense content rendering alongside character accuracy.
blocks.zh: 关于图像文本渲染的研究已经从明确的特征和布局控制发展到本土文本模型化和有针对性的完善. TextDiffuser, Glyph-ByT5, AnyText2 建立实用的布局规划,人物意识表现和属性控制机制(Chen等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年c;Tuo等人,2024年). 最近的工作通过互补的办法加强了这些能力。 Quen-Image将文本重点数据解析与扩展至段落级文本的渐进式培训相结合(Wu等人,2025b ). TextGuider通过注意力对齐处理文本省略问题,而DCText则使用预定的注意力罩将长弦或多弦分离到指定区域(Baek等人,2025年;Song等人,2025年)。 GlyphAnchor引入了位置焦虑的glyph前科,TextPecker通过对性格水平异常的敏感奖励来提高结构忠诚度(Xiang等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026年). PosterMaker和BizGen进一步研究产品海报和文章一级的图象(Gao等人,2025年;Peng等人,2025年)。 这些发展强调文本的完整性、位置和密集内容的渲染以及字符的准确性。

blocks.en: To embed visual text in meaningful scene contexts, we use category-specific construction templates that connect the intended writing to the depicted activity. DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) constructs prompts from human-screened scene seeds, specifying the text, its physical or interface carriers, and its semantic role. Shared constraints ensure that the writing serves a clear purpose and remains consistent with the scene, while category-specific requirements capture its different uses across the five application scenarios. The construction template is provided below.
blocks.zh: 要将视觉文本嵌入有意义的场景背景中,我们使用特定类别构建模板,将意图书写与描绘的活动联系起来. DeepSeek-V4-Flash(DeepSeek-AI,2026年)从人屏的场景种子中构造出提示,具体说明文字,其物理或界面载体,以及其语义作用. 共同的限制确保书写具有明确的目的,与现场保持一致,而具体类别的要求则涵盖其五种应用情景的不同用途。 施工模板如下。

blocks.en: Prompt Construction: System Prompt You are a scene designer who constructs text-rich video generation prompts for VTR-Bench. Your task is to turn each accepted scene seed into a complete scene description in which visible writing serves the depicted activity. You receive: - A scene category and a human-screened scene seed. - The core setting, event, textual purpose, and candidate carriers. - Case-specific text-length ranges and a maximum number of text groups. Your task is to: 1. Develop the supplied seed into a concrete scene with specific objects, intrinsic actions, and fictional identities where appropriate. 2. Compose original visible text that supports the activity, and assign each text group to a natural carrier. 3. Specify each group’s exact wording and semantic role, distinguishing the main textual anchor from supporting information and compact labels. Category requirements: - Advertising: use fictional identities and informative product copy. - Science: connect a complete explanation or derivation with evidence and interpretation. - User interfaces: describe one credible interface for a specific task. - Culture: embed writing in a practice, performance, transmission, or authorship. - Daily life: describe personal, household, family, or friend activities. Construction requirements: - Preserve the supplied scene, activity, and purpose. Each seed must yield an independent case with its own setting and original writing. - Build textual complexity through meaningful prose, data, instructions, formulas, dialogue, annotations, specifications, or records. - Use spatially coherent text groups. Prefer two or three when appropriate; one information-rich carrier is also allowed. Respect the supplied maximum and text-length constraints. - Keep the writing internally consistent and relevant to the action. Do not add carriers merely to distribute words or make text artificially small. - Assign exactly one group the role semantic_anchor. Other groups may be supporting_information or compact_label. - Describe what exists and happens in the scene. Exclude camera plans, video duration, rendering settings, benchmark terminology, and production instructions, including subtitles, credits, end cards, montage, or split-screen directives. - Keep scene and action fields as descriptive prose. Store exact visible strings in required_text rather than repeating or serializing them in those fields. - Preserve visible strings in their original language. Do not return word_units. {OUTPUT_FORMAT} Return one valid JSON object with a cases array containing every requested case. Preserve each case_id exactly. Do not include explanations, Markdown, or code fences.

blocks.en: B.2 Visual Feasibility Validation
blocks.zh: B.2 视觉可行性验证

blocks.en: Visual feasibility validation assesses whether the requested text can be coherently accommodated within the scene. For each candidate, three reference images generated by Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025b ) are jointly reviewed by Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) for carrier coverage, text hierarchy, and integration with the depicted activity. Revisions address structural problems that recur in at least two images and are attributable to the prompt, preserving the intended text and its semantic role. This separates prompt feasibility from the generator’s text-rendering accuracy. Validated prompts undergo final human review before inclusion in VTR-Bench. The review template is provided below.
blocks.zh: 视觉可行性验证评估了所请求的文本是否能够在现场内得到一致的容纳. 对于每个候选者,Quen-Image(Wu et al., 2025b)生成的3个参考图像由Quen3.8-27B(Quen Team, 2026c)联合审查,用于载体覆盖,文本等级,并与所描绘的活动融合. 修订涉及至少在两个图像中反复出现的结构性问题,这些问题可归因于及时保留预期文本及其语义作用。 这与生成器文本的准确性区分开来。 经验证的提示在被列入VTR-Bench之前经过最后的人文审查. 审查模板如下。

blocks.en: Visual Feasibility Validation: System Prompt You are a visual reviewer assessing whether a video generation prompt describes a coherent scene that naturally accommodates its required text. You receive: - Three independent reference images, the prompt, scene category, and required text targets. - The current review round and a maximum of three rounds. Your task is to: 1. Inspect all three images jointly for scene coherence, carrier organization, and the relationship between writing and action. Images have equal status and are diagnostic references, not video-conditioning inputs. 2. Identify recurring structural problems attributable to the prompt. 3. Return a verdict and, when justified and another round is available, a complete revised prompt. Review criteria: - The scene is specific and believable, not a generic poster, document wall, slide, dashboard, or flat typography sheet. - Every required text group has a plausible physical or interface carrier. - Important writing occupies sufficient image area at a human-readable scale. The hierarchy distinguishes the semantic anchor and supporting information, avoiding oversized words or uniformly microscopic text. - Writing supports the activity and makes relationships such as evidence and conclusion, identity and specification, or message and action understandable. - People, objects, and decoration do not consistently overwhelm the carriers. Decision rules: - Return revise only if the same structural problem occurs in at least two images and can reasonably be attributed to the prompt. Otherwise return pass. - Spelling errors, missing letters, malformed glyphs, incorrect formula characters, and inaccurate wording are not grounds for revision. - An isolated anatomy, object, layout, or typography failure is insufficient. Do not simplify benchmark requirements to accommodate the generator. Revision constraints: - Preserve the domain, core scene, activity, semantic relationships, and every required carrier, role_class, and verbatim string. - Include every verbatim string exactly once in revised_prompt_en. - Change only scene wording, spatial relationships, carrier prominence and scale, visual hierarchy, or actions that reveal textual relationships. - Keep the prompt content-only: no duration, timestamps, shot lists, camera or lens instructions, depth of field, resolution, coordinates, screen percentages, font-size numbers, planners, orchestration, captions, subtitles, credits, end cards, or evaluator instructions. - For pass, leave revised_prompt_en empty. On the final round, report unresolved problems but leave revised_prompt_en empty even for revise. {OUTPUT_FORMAT} Return JSON only. Include three per_image entries indexed 1, 2, and 3. For revise, set repeated_issue_attributable_to_prompt=true and provide cross-image evidence. The best_image_index is diagnostic and does not override joint review.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the results obtained with Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , allowing us to examine whether evaluator choice changes the model comparison.
blocks.zh: 表3报告了使用Quen3.6-27B(Quen Team,2026a)获得的结果,使我们能够审查评价员的选择是否改变了模型比较。

blocks.en: Table 3: Results on VTR-Bench evaluated by Qwen3.6-27B. Darker blue highlights indicate better results among the top three models in each score column. Ranks use overall WER and Video Score before rounding.
blocks.zh: 表3:由Quen3.6-27B评价的VTR-Bench结果. 更深蓝色的亮点表明,在每个分数列中前三名模型中,效果较好. 排名在四舍五入前使用整体WER和Video Score.

blocks.en: Both evaluators produce identical overall rankings for WER and Video Score across all 11 models, giving a Spearman correlation of 1.000 1.000 for each metric. Wan3.0, Minimax H3, and Seedance2.5 occupy the top three positions in text fidelity. Qwen3.6-27B assigns higher Video Scores throughout, but the largest difference in overall WER is 0.017. Evaluator choice therefore affects score calibration while preserving the ordering of model performance.
blocks.zh: 两位评价员对WER和Video Score所有11种模型的总体排名相同,给出了Spearman的关联性,每个度量衡为10001000. Wan3.0,Minimax H3,和种子2.5在文本忠诚度上占据前三名. Qune3.6-27B全程分配较高的视频分数,但整体WER的最大差异为0.017. 因此,评价员的选择影响分数校准,同时保留模型性能的顺序。

blocks.zh: 为了在评估者之间做出选择,我们利用同样的100个附加说明的视频,将第4.5节中的人类比较扩大到Quen3.6-27B。 表4报告关于联合调查判决和文本块和视频级WER的协议。

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B agrees with human CoQ judgments on 92.15% of queries, compared with 91.60% for Qwen3.6-27B, and performs better on all four text-block alignment metrics. At the video level, it also achieves higher Pearson correlation and Lin’s CCC, while Qwen3.6-27B has higher Spearman correlation and lower MAE. We select Qwen3.8-27B for the main evaluation based on its stronger agreement on individual queries and text blocks, the units on which the evaluation pipeline operates.
blocks.zh: Qwen3.8-27B同意人类对92.15%的查询的CoQ判断,而Quen3.6-27B的判断率为91.60%,在所有四个文本块对齐度量表上表现较好. 在视频方面,它也实现了较高的皮尔逊相关和林氏CC,而Quen3.6-27B则具有更高的斯皮尔曼相关和较低的MAE. 我们根据其对个别查询和文本块,即评价管道运作单位的更强有力的协议,选择Quen3.8-27B作为主要评价对象。

blocks.en: Table 6 separates Qwen3.8-27B’s Video Scores by dimension. Each score is the proportion of satisfied queries assigned to that dimension, pooled across scenarios; prompts without applicable queries do not contribute. Scene Attributes includes text-carrier presence and integration, whereas Entity Presence covers subjects and objects. The All column pools every query.

blocks.en: The dimension breakdown distinguishes scene fulfillment from dynamic requirements. Across all 11 models, Scene Attributes, Entity Presence, and Spatial Relationship receive higher scores than Motion Adherence and Temporal Consistency. Wan3.0 leads the first three dimensions, while HappyHorse1.1 achieves the highest Motion Adherence and shares the highest Temporal Consistency with Seedance2.5. The overall score thus combines distinct strengths in scene composition and temporal behavior.
blocks.zh: 尺寸分解将场景满足与动态要求区分开来. 在所有11个模型中,场景属性、实体存在和空间关系得到的分数高于运动遵守度和时间一致性。 Wan3.0领先前三个维度,而HappyHorse1.1则实现了最高的运动遵守,并与种子2.5共享最高的时态一致性. 因此,总体分数结合了场景构成和时间行为上的不同优势.

blocks.en: Models with similar overall scores can nevertheless differ in which requirements they fulfill. Kling v3.0 and Seedance2.5 both achieve an overall Video Score of approximately 0.79, yet Kling scores higher on Spatial Relationship, at 0.8118 versus 0.7503, whereas Seedance scores higher on Temporal Consistency, at 0.7049 versus 0.6361. The aggregate score brings these different profiles close together. Reporting individual dimensions makes the distinction explicit and helps identify whether a model’s stronger performance lies in arranging scene elements or maintaining the requested behavior over time. This breakdown complements the overall comparison by tying scores to specific generation requirements.
blocks.zh: 但是,总体分数相似的模型在满足哪些要求方面可能有所不同。 Kling v3.0和种子2.5都取得了大约0.79的总的视频得分,然而Kling在空间关系方面的得分却更高,为0.8118比0.7503,而种子在时间一致性方面的得分较高,为0.7049比0.6361。 汇总分数使这些不同的剖面图接近. 报告单个维度可以明确区分,并有助于确定一个模型更强的性能是否在于安排场景要素,或者在一段时间内保持所要求的行为. 这一细目通过将分数与具体的生成要求挂钩来补充总体比较。

blocks.en: C.5 Extended Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: C.5 扩展失败分析

blocks.en: To examine what makes rendered text difficult to read, we analyze the evaluators’ transcription diagnostics : one- or two-sentence descriptions of observable difficulties, produced during transcription when an entire target is unreadable or unreadable spans are omitted. These descriptions concern the target as a whole rather than individual word errors.
blocks.zh: 为了审查是什么使得文本难以阅读,我们分析了评估员的笔录诊断:当整个目标无法读取或无法读取时,在笔录中对可观察到的困难作了一、两次判决说明。 这些描述涉及整个目标,而不是单个字错误.

blocks.en: Pooling Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.6-27B outputs for 13,213 text targets yields 6,433 diagnostics for unreadable targets and 6,549 accompanying transcriptions. Figure 8 shows word occurrences within the selected diagnostic vocabulary. Each evaluator’s description is counted separately, and a description may contain multiple terms.
blocks.zh: 集合Qwen3.8-27B和Qwen3.6-27B为13 213个文本目标产出,为无法读取的目标提供6 433个诊断结果和6 549个随附的抄本。 图8显示选定诊断词汇中的单词发生. 每个评价者的描述单独计算,描述可能包含多个术语.

blocks.en: (a) Diagnostics for unreadable targets.
blocks.zh: (a) 不可读目标的诊断。

blocks.en: (b) Diagnostics accompanying transcriptions.
blocks.zh: (b) 抄录的诊断。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Word frequencies in transcription diagnostics pooled from Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.6-27B. (a) 6,433 descriptions for unreadable targets. (b) 6,549 descriptions accompanying transcriptions. Counts show the 15 most frequent terms within each selected diagnostic vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 图8:从Quen3.8-27B和Quen3.6-27B汇总的转录诊断中的文字频率。 (a) 对无法读取的目标的6 433个描述。 (b) 6 549份抄录的描述。 计数显示每个选定的诊断词汇中最常见的15个术语.

blocks.en: Unreadable text is most often associated with insufficient character detail. In Figure 8a , small and blurry dominate the diagnostics, with 3,595 and 3,196 occurrences, followed by illegible and resolution . The vocabulary connects unreadability to the visibility of the rendered characters: a carrier can be recognizable as a sign, document, or interface while its writing lacks enough detail for transcription. Handwriting, viewing distance, and distortion also recur, indicating that the difficulty extends across different carrier appearances and viewing conditions. These observations help explain why the presence of a text-bearing object does not establish that its content can be recovered.
blocks.zh: 无法读取的文本最常与字符细节不足有关. 在图8a中,小而模糊的诊断占了主导地位,有3 595和3 196起,其次是难以辨认和分辨率。 词汇将不可读性与渲染的字符的能见度联系起来:一个载体可以识别为标志,文件,或界面,而其写作缺乏足够的细节来进行抄写. 手写,取景距离和扭曲也反复出现,表明难度延伸到不同的载体外观和取景条件. 这些观察有助于解释为什么一个带有文本的物体的存在不能证实其内容可以收回。

blocks.en: Recoverable text combines visibility problems with errors in the rendered content. Figure 8b is led by partially , with 1,645 occurrences, while obscured and blurry appear 1,363 and 1,338 times. These descriptions capture cases where some text remains accessible despite incomplete visibility or limited detail. At the same time, misspelled and garbled occur 602 and 480 times. Thus, obtaining a transcription does not imply that the recovered words are well formed or correct. This distinction clarifies why transcription outcomes and WER describe different aspects of the same target: the former records whether text can be recovered, while the latter measures its correspondence to the requested content.
blocks.zh: 可恢复文本将可见度问题与提供的内容错误结合起来。 图8b部分显示1 645起事件,而模糊不清的1 363次和1 338次。 这些描述记录了一些尽管不完全可见或细节有限但仍可以查阅的案文。 同时,拼写错误和涂装出现602次和480次. 因此,获得抄录并不意味着所找到的字句形成良好或正确。 这种区分澄清了为什么转录结果和WER描述同一目标的不同方面:前者记录是否可以收回文本,而后者衡量其与所请求的内容的对应.

blocks.en: The visual cases illustrate how these difficulties appear in generated scenes. ViduQ3 and Kling v3.0 produce structured interfaces whose prominent text contains pseudo-words. HappyHorse1.1 mixes recognizable fragments with malformed words, while Lingbot-Video-Dense produces abnormal Chinese stroke combinations. The Minimax H3 and LTX-2.3 examples further distinguish distorted handwriting from text that lacks readable detail. Across these cases, the surrounding layout can remain recognizable even when the writing fails at the level of words or character formation. The enlarged crops show how these failures affect the writing on each carrier, linking the visible error to its role within the depicted scene.
blocks.zh: 视觉案例说明了这些困难是如何出现在生成的场景中的. ViduQ3和Kling v3.0生成结构化界面,其显著文本包含伪词. HappyHorse1.1将可识别的碎片与畸形词混合,而Lingbot-Video-Dense则产生异常的中风组合. Minimax H3和LTX-2.3的例子进一步区分了扭曲的笔迹和缺乏可读细节的文本. 在这些案例中,即使文字在文字或字符形成层面失败,周围的布局仍然可以识别. 扩大的作物显示了这些故障如何影响每个载体上的书写,将可见错误与其在所描绘的场景中的角色联系起来.

blocks.en: Content fidelity also requires checking text that appears legible. The final cases show errors that are directly exposed by the required-text comparison: Wan3.0 replaces β = 8 / 3 \beta=8/3 with β = 4 / 3 \beta=4/3 , Seedance2.5 substitutes a brief update for the requested timing and temperature details, and HunyuanVideo-1.5 renders a prompt instruction fragment as storefront text. These examples connect numerical substitution, information omission, and unintended instruction rendering to the benchmark’s explicit textual requirements. Together, the diagnostics and visual cases identify two complementary targets for improvement: making scene text recoverable and preserving the information it is supposed to convey. For applications built around written instructions, records, or numerical specifications, this distinction is consequential: faithfully depicting the carrier is one part of fulfilling the request; the text must also preserve the intended message.
blocks.zh: 内容忠贞还需要检查看起来可以辨认的文本. 最终案例显示通过所需文本比较直接暴露的错误 : Wan3.0将β=8 / 3\β=8/3改为β=4 / 3\β=4/3,种子2.5取代了所要求的时间和温度细节的简短更新,HunyuanVideo-1.5将快速指令片段作为存储前缀文本. 这些例子将数字替换、信息遗漏和意想不到的指令与基准的明确文字要求联系起来。 诊断和视觉病例共同确定了两个补充性改进目标:使现场文本可以恢复,并保存它应该传递的信息。 对于围绕书面指示、记录或数字规格构建的应用程序,这种区分是必然的:忠实地描绘承运人是满足请求的一部分;案文还必须保留所要发出的信息。
